import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_28/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_28/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source3_28_0 and Source3_28_1 on 'city'
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by city, type, driver_count and aggregate average fare and ride count
agg_df = df_joined.groupby(["city", "type", "driver_count"], as_index=False).agg(
    {"fare": "mean", "ride_id": "count"}
)

# Rename columns to match target schema
agg_df.rename(
    columns={
        "fare": "Average Fare",
        "ride_id": "Ride Count",
    },
    inplace=True,
)

# Reorder columns to match target schema: ['city', 'driver_count', 'type', 'Average Fare', 'Ride Count']
Target3_28 = agg_df[["city", "driver_count", "type", "Average Fare", "Ride Count"]]

# Ensure correct dtypes
Target3_28["driver_count"] = Target3_28["driver_count"].astype(int)
Target3_28["Ride Count"] = Target3_28["Ride Count"].astype(int)
Target3_28["Average Fare"] = Target3_28["Average Fare"].astype(float)
Target3_28["city"] = Target3_28["city"].astype(str)
Target3_28["type"] = Target3_28["type"].astype(str)

# Write the final target table to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_28/target_multisource.csv"
Target3_28.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_28/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_28/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (inner join to keep only matching cities)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', on='city')

# Group by city, driver_count, type (leftmost non-float unique columns in target schema)
# Aggregate average fare and count of ride_id
result = joined.groupby(['city', 'driver_count', 'type'], as_index=False).agg(
    **{
        'Average Fare': ('fare', 'mean'),
        'Ride Count': ('ride_id', 'count')
    }
)

# Write output with exact target schema column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_28/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
